text:
taylor: Quick sync — ACME private offer. Need to finalize pricing ladder + early-renewal credit that we can show in marketplace listing. Thinking: 10% front-loaded credit for first renew cycle, then phased 5% -> 2.5% over 18 months. Thoughts?

jess: +1 on front-loaded. But need to confirm accounting for reserved capacity SKU mapping. Ops will hate recon if we create a new transient SKU.

kumar: Can we gate the credit by usage velocity? e.g., if customer hits 70% of committed spend in Q1, they get an extra 5% voucher applied at renewal. That reduces gaming.

taylor: Good call. So two levers: front-loaded onboarding credit + usage-velocity kicker. Need to ensure marketplace private-offer UI supports conditional credits; I think Azure/GCP allow custom line-item credits but not conditional ones.

eva: For GCP marketplace we can ship a billing unit that represents "onboarding-credit" and then reconcile offline for velocity kicker. Not ideal but doable. For AWS Marketplace private offers, we can push a second invoice line. Need partner ops to sign off.

alex: From sales POV — co-announcement timing matters. If we show a big credit in marketplace listing before SI enablement, field will oversell and customers will expect immediate implementations. Recommend hold listing until SI playbook is ready (2 weeks).

jess: Agreed. Also we need the joint announcement checklist: partner-approved collateral, SI enablement slides, marketplace listing copy, and a support playbook for consumption disputes.

kumar: Can we use a short, explicit clause in the private-offer terms: "onboarding credits applied at first renewal subject to committed usage verification" to reduce noise?

taylor: Yes. Legal OK with that phrasing? CCing @announce-bot for calendar slot.

announce-bot: Calendar event created: ACME private-offer sync — 1766544000 (in 15m). Participants: taylor, jess, kumar, eva, alex.

eva: Ops question — if we do front-loaded credit as a negative line item, how does that show in token-level cost reports? We should map credits to customer_cost_tags so Console shows true unit economics.

jess: Good point. Add to rollout ticket: Tag credits with `credit_type:onboarding` and `partner:acme`. That way Optimize and Console can filter.

kumar: Implementation note for eng-runtime: prefer not to create new SKU on calling path. Use billing metadata on existing SKU and apply negative adjustment in billing pipeline. I can draft event schema: 
```
{"customer_id": "C123", "offer_id": "ACME-PVT-2026", "credit_type": "onboarding", "amount_usd": 50000}
```

kumar: That keeps serving code unchanged and lets billing team apply offsets.

taylor: Perfect. Can someone draft the marketplace copy that obfuscates the complex mechanics but communicates the customer value? Something short: "Up to 10% onboarding credit + acceleration incentives for early usage"

eva: I'll draft. Will also add SI enablement bullet points: deployment runbook, estimated time-to-value, top 3 KPIs for customer success.

alex: Sales request: include a renewal uplift play for ARR motion — suggested script and slide for AE to use.

jess: I'll own AE slide + support playbook. Kumar, can you own the billing event draft?

kumar: Yep, will drop PR to billing repo today and ping ops.

taylor: OK — action items: (1) Eva: marketplace copy + SI bullets (2) Jess: AE slide + support playbook (3) Kumar: billing event PR + reconciliation plan (4) Alex: field comms draft (5) Taylor: finalize partner messaging and secure announcement window after SI signoff.

alex: One more ask — can we include a 30-day usage onboarding email template sent via partner co-marketing that nudges customers to hit velocity? Small frictionless CTA.

eva: I'll add the email template to the collateral doc.

taylor: Thanks team. If no objections I'll lock pricing ladder and terms by EOD and update the private-offer draft.

jess: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

kumar: Looks good.

eva: Good to ship.

announce-bot: Message archived to #partnerships — thread 1766543210.
